name: Navidrome Remote
author: ky
description: What is playing on Navidrome from any device, with transport controls for clients that allow them.

barWidget.description: Shows what is playing on your Navidrome server from any client — Kodi, phone, tablet, cliamp — with a live progress bar, and play/pause/next/previous for clients that expose a remote API. Hidden while nothing is playing.

schema.label: Hide from the bar when nothing is playing
